notes.title: Physics Update
notes.notes:
Christmas brings many presents and this update brings physics, storage control and sound effects.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33904043/39c37b52abfd589f4149c71759d0f44d2171e3d4.png

Using physics we can now launch items over conveyors and buildings or up mountains, drop items onto conveyors below, stack the conveyors with ridiculous amounts of items etc.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33904043/9dcfccafee628bcee1d793823578bef1801a856f.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33904043/5e899d6b2596f84241f93bb67b2a7771232a41cf.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33904043/f3cf8367001f5684665f6347e4702e1c96f2c4c5.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33904043/7552a95a7d60603c290b4e3f8571032fae4cc65b.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33904043/63a19f7fdec51bbdb3ea3b7c19678105e9cc68a3.png

Storages can now be set to release items and to which directions.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33904043/b207e0a52f5f6c2ea073bf64c648edb01aff2d2c.png

And the first sound effects for buildings when they are active have been implemented.

notes.title: Transportation Upgrade Update
notes.notes:
Hi cubics,


 This first official update brings better looking conveyors and lifts:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33904043/8059a91b42900108fa70ceb155aee4b9551d63b3.png



 Lifts can also now stack:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33904043/73c2026bfc2afb15c794fbfa88518789fe43c211.png


The old elevators will still load for existing save games however they are not buildable anymore.


 Also new, the distributor to split or merge lanes and the filter conveyor, use these together to filter a mixed conveyor lane:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33904043/71b1cc36b7792d130a218b29a7e46b24913315bb.png

For now these are available without research.

Just some basic keyboard commands:
WASD - Move camera
E - Copy building at mouse cursor OR Clear building for construction
C - Clear item from conveyor
DEL - Destroy building
CTRL /ALT - Show building/conveyor overlays

Still working on the UI so you will see alot of continuing changes there.

Please note that this is still Early Access which means there will be updates, new features and improvements as well as bugs and rebalancing.
